translation.name: Kitapm kɛn Raa dɔɔko kiji ute jeege

content: Ɔɔɗki dose naatn ro *kusin̰ ki
Taa naan̰ se ɓo Ꞌjeelki, *al‑Masi ɓaaɗo do naaŋ ki se dabarga. Bin num naase kic Ꞌɗaapki rose gɛn dabar aan gɔɔ naan̰ kici. Ɔɔ debm jaay dabarga se, mɔɔtn Ꞌkɔŋ kɔl don̰ maakŋ kusin̰ ki ey sum.
Ɓiisen ɔɔpm kɛn anki tiŋg do naaŋ ki se, ɔn̰te Ꞌtɛɗki nakŋ kɛn maakse ɓo jea, num Ꞌtɛɗki nakŋ kɛn tɔɔl *Raa ki.

Ɗeere, maakŋ kiŋgse kɛn do dɔkin̰ se, naase Ꞌtɛɗkiro nakgen jig ey dɛna aan gɔɔ jee jeel Raa mal eyo. Naase Ꞌlee ɛɛskiro naapa, Ꞌlee dɔŋkiro nakŋ jeege, Ꞌlee aay oonkiro, Ꞌlee Ꞌjekiro kɔs bɛɛ salal, ɔŋkiga gɔtn kaaye lɛ aay Ꞌdeelkiro te gɔtin̰a ɔɔ Ꞌlee Ꞌtɛɗkiro maraggen Raa jeɗe eyo paac paac.
Ɓɔrse jaay naase Ꞌtɛɗki aan gɔɔ naaɗe ey se, naaɗe aaksen se paac ɓo ɔkɗen taaɗ eyo. Taa naan̰ se naaɗe lee naajse.
Gaŋ ɓii kalaŋ Raa kɛn utu Ꞌkɔjn̰ bɔɔrɔ do jeege tun ooyga kooyo ɔɔ do jeege tun zɛɛr se, utu Ꞌtɔnd mɛtɗe do nakɗe kɛn jig ey naaɗe tɛɗ se.

Jee ooyga kooy do dɔkin̰ se kic ɓo, Isa ɓaa taaɗɗenoga Labar Jiga se kici. Taa naan̰ se ɓo, naaɗe kic Raa ɔjɗenga bɔɔrɔ doɗe ki aan gɔɔ jikilimgen ɓaa se paac. Bin se ute *Nirl Raa se, naaɗe Ꞌkɔŋ Ꞌkiŋg aan gɔɔ kɛn Raa jen ro ki.
Naŋa naŋa kic ɓo Raa ɛɗin̰ naabin̰ naabin̰a
Duni se ɔɔpga baata Ꞌnaŋa. Taa naan̰ se iŋgki do mɛtɛkse ki ɔɔ Ꞌɗaapki rose taa aki keem Raa.
Kɛn cir paac paac se, Ꞌjeki naapa ute maakŋ kalaŋ, taa ute maak‑jese se, kɛn deba tɛɗi *kusin̰a aan gɔɔ ɗi kic ɓo an̰ kɔŋ tɛɗn kalɗɛ.
Jee kɛn ɓaaɗo gɔtse ki se, ɔkɗeki jiga ɔɔ ɔn̰te tɛɗɗeki bɛs.
ꞋJeelki naŋa naŋa kic ɓo Raa ɛɗin̰ga naabin̰ naabin̰a. Bin se Ꞌnoogki naapa, taa naase se Ꞌtɛɗkiga jee tɛɗn naabm Raage gɛn tɛɗn naabgen paacn̰ kɛn naan̰ ɛɗsesin̰ se, ute ɗoobin̰a.

Debm jeel taaɗn taara se, n̰Ꞌtaaɗ taar Raa jeege tu. Ɔɔ debm Raa ɛɗin̰ga maak‑je gɛn tɛɗn naaba jeege tu se, n̰Ꞌtɛɗin̰ ute tɔɔgŋ kɛn Raa ɛɗin̰ se. Ute naan̰ se jaay ɓo, jeege paac Ꞌtɔɔm Raa ute ɗoobm Isa *al‑Masi. Naan̰ ɓo debm magala ɔɔ tɔɔgɔ gɛn daayum daayum! *Amin.
Jee kɛn kꞋdabarɗe taa *al‑Masi
Jee maak‑jemge, nakŋ ɔɔn̰ jaay aanga dose ki se, ɔn̰te kaakin̰ki aan gɔɔ nakŋ deel doa ɔɔ ɔksen taaɗ eyo. Num aakin̰ aan gɔɔ nakŋ kɛn lee aan kaan do jeege tu tap.
Num kɛn naase jaay Ꞌdabarki taa al‑Masi se, ɔn̰ki maakse Ꞌraapo. Taa ɓiin naan̰ aɗe ɓaa maakŋ gaarin̰ ki se, naase kic utu aki kɔŋ maak‑raapm gɛn taaɗ eyo.
Kɛn kꞋnaajse taa Isa al‑Masi se, ɔn̰ki maakse Ꞌraapo. Taa *Nirl Salal kɛn ɔk *nooko kɛn iin̰o gɔtn Raa se, Ꞌtɛɗn ute naase.
Anum maakse ki se, nam jꞋɔn̰te dabarin̰ taa tɔɔl nam, taa ɓoogo, taa tɛɗn *kusin̰a, ey lɛ taa ɔl don̰ maakŋ taar jeege tu.
Num kɛn kꞋdabarin̰ taa al‑Masi se, sɔkɔn̰ɔ ɔn̰te tɔɔlin̰a naɓo n̰Ꞌtɔɔm Raa taa jeege daŋin̰ naan̰ debm al‑Masi.

Kaaɗ kɛn Raa an kɔjn̰ bɔɔrɔ do jeege tu se, ɓɔrse aanga. Ɔɔ kɛn Raa jaay Ꞌbaagŋ kɔjn̰ bɔɔrɔ do jee naan̰ge tu ɓo deet se, bin num jee kɛn jaay baate tookŋ kaal maakɗe do Labar Jigan gɛn Raa ki se, Ꞌtɛɗn ɔɔ ɗio?
Taa Kitap taaɗ ɔɔ:

content.text: Kɛn jee tɛɗn nakgen ute ɗoobin̰ kic ɓo, utu ɔɔn̰ jaay Ꞌkɔŋ kaaja se,
num jee aal Raa maak ki eyo ute jee kusin̰ge se tap ɓo kꞋtɛɗn roɗe jꞋɔɔ ɗio

content: Bin ɓo, jee kɛn Raa je ɔɔ naaɗe Ꞌdabar se, jꞋaay kaamɗe kꞋtɛɗ nakŋ bɛɛ. Taa Raa kɛn tuj ɔrmin̰ ey se, naan̰ ɓo Mɛl Kaalɗe ɔɔ jꞋɔn̰ roɗe kaam jin̰a.
